items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: In 1936, Gus Wilson the brother of Teddy Wilson was with our band

ctx.x: Uh-huh, they're good -- Wilson was in that '36 deal, but he and Chester Lane -- when Booker came in, you know, we all live on --
That's right, that's right. In 1936, Gus Wilson the brother of Teddy Wilson was with our band, and with Gus we never could get him to really settle down and, in a business like way --
